title: Grandchild in trouble
description: A caller pretending to be a grandchild needs bail money, wants it kept secret, and asks for gift cards.

lines.text: Oh, hello love! Is everything alright?
Not really. I'm in a bit of trouble and I really need your help.

verdict.reason: Someone needs help, but nothing has been asked for yet.
verdict.next_action: Listen carefully. Don't agree to pay anything.

lines.text: I was in a car accident, and the police say I have to pay bail today or they'll keep me in overnight.

verdict.reason: A relative in sudden trouble needs money fast. This is a common scam story.
verdict.next_action: Don't pay anything yet. Hang up and call them back on the number you already have.

lines.text: I'm okay, just shaken. Please don't tell Mum, she'll be so upset with me.

verdict.reason: They want money fast and want you to keep it secret.
verdict.next_action: Hang up and call your grandchild or their parents on a number you already have.

lines.text: Can you go to the shop and buy five hundred pounds of gift cards?

evidence: buy five hundred pounds of gift cards
verdict.reason: Bail is never paid in gift cards. This is a scam.
verdict.next_action: Don't buy any gift cards. Hang up and call your family on a number you already have.

lines.text: Then read me the numbers on the back. I'll stay on the line while you go.
